text.p: Furniture Brands International Inc said Monday it completed a refinancing of its secured credit agreement, resulting in an annual per share savings of $0.05 to $0.06.
The company said it will take a one-time net charge of $7.4 million in third quarter as a result of the refinancing. The charge will be accounted for as an extraordinary item.

The new agreement is a five-year revolving credit facility with an initial commitment totaling $475 million. It was underwritten by Bankers Trust Co, NationsBank N.A., and Credit Lyonnais New York branch, the company said.

Furniture Brands said the agreement gives the company increased flexibility and lower interest rates. It said the refinancing was made possible by its strong operating performance and significant debt reduction during the first half of 1996.
Furniture Brands said the savings will result in a $0.05 to $0.06 per share increase in net earnings annually, which will begin to show up in the fourth quarter.
The company also said it boutht about 2.3 million Series 1 Warrants, or about 44 percent of the warrants outstanding when the company announced its buy-back program last July.
